name: Mother Against Daughter
overview: Scripture reveals that spiritual truth and allegiance to Christ can bring division even within the closest family relationships, including between mother and daughter. Micah 7:6 and Luke 12:53 emphasize that enmity may arise among relatives as individuals choose Christ over familial ties. This division is not a sign of failure but a consequence of the radical commitment Jesus calls for, as He warns that His coming will bring division rather than peace (Luke 12:51). Believers are therefore called to remain steadfast, recognizing that loyalty to Christ sometimes means standing against even those closest to us.
